items.prompt: With k=3 and stream [4,1,9], what is emitted at the third arrival?

options.why: The rank is third-largest, not largest.
There are now exactly k observations, so the warm-up period has ended.
The sorted prefix is [9,4,1], whose third value is 1.
That is the second-largest of this prefix, not the third.
